name: smwmusic-thegremlin-keep-pace-with-the-devil-hell-race-remix
title: TheGremlin - 🔥 Keep Pace With The Devil 🔥 - HELL-RACE (Remix)
description:
A nostalgic throwback of a really old track remixed for a new generation. Fits bosses, frantic final levels, or fiery inferno levels.

You can toggle the KeyCorrection define if you want it far less chromatic. I personally like the original.

Credit for both me and the original composer would be appreciated!

Omits @7, @12, @14, @17, @15, and Thunder.brr. No Yoshi/blargg/thunder/firework; no P-switch/Bonus End.

Update: Removed echo. It made zero difference.
